story: In the diverse world of birds, the Banded Woodpecker (Chrysophlegma miniaceum) stands out. This species, part of the Picidae family, is a resident of Primary rainforest; secondary forest; plantations; mangroves; parks; wooded suburbs; and gardens. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Banded Woodpecker is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Banded Woodpecker and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
